scope: Offline synthetic operator graph selection; no complete model or native serving changes.

fair_no_stats_baselines.note: Fixed baselines omit the histogram and all feedback. Adaptive includes both. Same 48 input fixtures, frozen policy, all numeric checks pass.

limitations: Synthetic checkpoint-shaped weights/routing on RTX4060 Laptop; no full-model throughput, acceptance, KV/Conv/SSM or A100 result.
CPU chooses pre-captured graphs from lagged asynchronous route summaries. No device-conditional CUDA Graph nodes are implemented.
Model uses exact capacity, interpolation in P and effective expert count, plus a switch margin. It does not model the entire expert histogram or all possible route correlations.
Equal-weight 48-case operator mix is an artificial comparison workload. Oracle means best of the six measured candidates per case, not a deployable foresight scheduler.
GPU event medians describe queued graph replay; CPU submit costs and isolated histogram costs are reported separately. Small negative overhead/regret values are measurement noise.
The summaries use only valid P/D routes. Physical padding work is priced by measured capacity/P curves. Padding and unseen routing regimes can still cause prediction error.
Formal serving and original Draft/Verify Graphs remain unchanged. Full MixedTargetGraph is not exercised.
main_matrix_baseline_note: The six fixed candidates in the main matrix include identical routing statistics for oracle assessment. Net benefit against a fixed graph must use summary.fair_no_stats_baselines.
